note: Walking on snow (Part C plan 7, coordinator's yes 10 Nov 2026; src/shared/snow_walk.gd). On ground whose surface material is one of soils, the walk is pace_mult as fast and exertion effort_mult as hard. Worn Snowshoes (an items.json row with snow_walk: true, feet slot) bring that to shod_pace_mult and shod_effort_mult. The client applies the pace (it moves the body), the server the exertion. No snow depth exists yet: the lying weather snow is a 0..1 look (weather_sounds ground_snow), not metres, so it does not slow anyone. If a depth comes, the coordinator's rule is: full multipliers at full_depth_m or deeper, scaling up from none below that.
